# algolia Provider

Terraform provider for Algolia.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    algolia = {
      source = "ECCOShoes/algolia"
    }
  }
}

provider "algolia" {
  app_id  = var.algolia_app_id
  api_key = var.algolia_api_key
}

# Both settings may instead be supplied via environment variables:
#   ALGOLIA_APP_ID, ALGOLIA_API_KEY
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Algolia Admin API key with permission to manage index settings and API keys. May also be set via the ALGOLIA_API_KEY environment variable.
- `app_id` (String) Algolia application ID. May also be set via the ALGOLIA_APP_ID environment variable.
